title: Claims Data CDC Pipeline
summary: Near real-time ingestion of claims data for a rules engine.
problem: Claims data reached analysts through manual extracts and was days old by the time it was used.
built: CDC replication from MySQL with AWS DMS into an S3 lake, Glue transforms, and modeled Snowflake tables managed in dbt.
impact: EDIT: e.g. refresh time cut from 6 hours to 20 minutes.

title: dbt Modeling Layer for Underwriting
summary: A tested, documented semantic layer for underwriting analytics.
problem: Business logic was copied across dashboards, so the same metric showed different numbers.
built: Staging, intermediate and mart models with tests, snapshots for history, and auto-generated docs.
impact: EDIT: e.g. 200+ models with tests, one source of truth for 10+ dashboards.

title: AI Product Usage Analytics
summary: Usage and adoption tracking for an internal AI assistant.
problem: The product team had no view of who used the tool, how often, or where people dropped off.
built: Event data modeled into session and user tables, served in a Tableau dashboard with adoption funnels.
impact: EDIT: e.g. used in monthly product reviews to prioritize features.

title: Serverless Decryption UDF for Athena
summary: Query encrypted fields in place without moving data.
problem: Sensitive fields had to be decrypted in separate jobs before anyone could query them.
built: A Lambda-backed Athena UDF with packaged dependencies and a Makefile-driven build and deploy.
impact: EDIT: e.g. removed a nightly job and cut query setup from hours to seconds.

title: #WorkoutWednesday Challenges
summary: Weekly Tableau challenges that push advanced techniques.
problem: Stay sharp on advanced Tableau: LODs, parameters, dynamic zones and custom charts.
built: Rebuilt each weekly challenge from scratch and published it on Tableau Public.

title: #MakeoverMonday Redesigns
summary: Redesigning real-world charts to be clearer and more honest.
problem: Practice turning messy public data into a clear story in under an hour.
built: Weekly redesigns focused on chart choice, labeling and a single clear takeaway.
impact: EDIT: e.g. featured in the weekly recap.
